description.value: At 14th level, as a free action, when using an ability or effect that requires a saving throw, the gambler may choose to roll a 1d3 instead of imposing the ability's usual saving throw type on his target(s). On a roll of 1, the target must make a Fortitude save; on a 2, a Reflex save; and on a 3, a Will save. If multiple effects with different saving throws are being imposed, this ability changes all imposed saving throw types to match the result of the roll.
